procedure.method: Independent fresh critique of the exact pinned request, case, rules, rubric and compact method. The packet declares no source assets or protected layouts, so their receipt arrays are explicitly empty. Read all five pinned native-evidence manifests before poster viewing, without opening their unlisted embedded input/producer/generated-image paths. Verified the exact manifest and poster byte pins and PNG headers separately; that verification was not treated as image viewing. Actually opened and visually inspected, through tools.view_image with detail original and displayed image output, M1 native then usage720 then thumbnail320, followed by the same three views for M2, M3, M4 and M5: all 15 exact poster views completed before the first deliberate copy reading/transcription, judgment or score. First readings below were then made from the already displayed native pixels in member/copy order, retaining their visible line breaks; there was no ambiguity-triggered revisit. No source opens occurred because none were supplied; all 15 poster opens succeeded and are individually attested below. No peer records, producer self-inspections, additional views, image edits, generation, spawn, fork or resume were used. Native dimensions are M1/M2 1672x941 and M3/M4/M5 1024x1536. M1/M2 are not mathematically exact 16:9: the nearest-integer single-edge policy accepts height 941 versus ideal 940.5, deviation 0.5 px. M3/M4/M5 are mathematically exact 2:3. Usage views are 720x405 for M1/M2 and 720x1080 for M3/M4/M5; thumbnails are 320x180 and 213x320 respectively, with aspect preserved to integer dimensions. All PNGs have RGB color type 2, with no alpha. Session identity is unavailable inside this critique and remains null; no serialized opening/tool event or external session identity is invented.
